"The launch of the 47 County Syndemic Operational Plans gives us more than a roadmap, it gives us a shared commitment to act. While Kenya has made remarkable progress in reducing new HIV infections and AIDS-related deaths, we must remain focused on the populations we are leaving behind. Progress is not success until every child, every adolescent, every young person and every vulnerable Kenyan has access to the services they need."
Douglas O. Bosire, CEO, NSDCC
"The resilience demonstrated by counties during the funding disruptions proved that Kenya's HIV response is not built on donor support alone, it is anchored in committed healthcare workers, empowered communities, and strong county leadership. Our next task is to make that resilience sustainable."
Nelson Otuoma, CEO, NEPHAK
"The launch of the 47 County Syndemic Operational Plans marks a defining moment in Kenya's health journey. These plans move us from commitment to action and place counties firmly at the centre of ending AIDS and other syndemic diseases as public health threats by 2030."
Hon. Aden Duale, Cabinet Secretary

About NSDCC
The National Syndemic Diseases Control Council (NSDCC) is a State Corporation established under Section 3 of the State Corporations Act, Cap 446, through the National AIDS Control Council Order, 1999 as amended by legal notice number 143 of 2022. The Council is mandated to manage the following syndemic diseases; HIV, sexually transmitted infections, malaria, leprosy, tuberculosis and lung disease.

About NSDCC
The National Syndemic Diseases Control Council (NSDCC) is a State Corporation established under Section 3 of the State Corporations Act, Cap 446, through the National AIDS Control Council Order, 1999 as amended by legal notice number 143 of 2022. The Council is mandated to manage the following syndemic diseases; HIV, sexually transmitted infections, malaria, leprosy, tuberculosis and lung disease.

Health Committee Explores Sustainable Solutions for Kenya’s HIV and Syndemic Disease Response
The National Assembly Departmental Committee on Health chaired by Hon. (Dr.) James Nyikal, MP, visited the National Syndemic Diseases Control Council (NSDCC) for a briefing on Kenya’s coordinated response to HIV and other syndemic diseases. The Committee was received by NSDCC Board Chairman Hon. Ahmed Ibrahim, Board Member Tom Okundi, Chief Executive Officer Douglas O. Bosire, and the Council’s Management Team.
Further, the Members of Parliament reviewed progress in the national response and discussed strategies for strengthening domestic resource mobilization, integrating HIV, tuberculosis, viral hepatitis, mental health, substance use disorders and non-communicable diseases, and advancing the legislative, policy and budgetary measures needed to sustain the response amid declining external funding.
The engagement reaffirmed the critical role of parliamentary oversight and collaboration in sustaining the gains made in Kenya’s HIV response and accelerating progress towards ending HIV and other syndemic diseases as public health threats by 2030.

About NSDCC
The National Syndemic Diseases Control Council (NSDCC) is a State Corporation established under Section 3 of the State Corporations Act, Cap 446, through the National AIDS Control Council Order, 1999 as amended by legal notice number 143 of 2022. The Council is mandated to manage the following syndemic diseases; HIV, sexually transmitted infections, malaria, leprosy, tuberculosis and lung disease.
